attributes.board_name: Mississippi Board of Examiners for Social Workers and Marriage & Family Therapists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Automatically approved: NASW (national or chapter), AAMFT, CSWE-accredited schools of social work, ASWB or affiliated state boards, IASW, IFSSW; board Designated Providers; other offerings must be pre-approved by the SW CE Committee; academic courses (1 graduate semester hour = 5 h)
rules.carryover: Unused hours completed within 3 years before the current expiration date may carry over, except ethics and cultural diversity hours.
rules.audit_note: At renewal, licensee submits a list of hours with an attestation statement.
rules.legal_basis: Miss. Admin. Code Title 30, Part 1902, Rules 4.1-4.2

topics.who: Cultural diversity / multicultural issues / cultural competency awareness
Mandated reporting for all client populations (since 7/1/2020)
Board-approved LCSW supervisors (not at first renewal after approval)

rules.new_licensee_rule: LMSWs with no previous license submit no CE at first renewal; LMSWs upgrading from LSW and LCSWs (upgrading from LMSW) do submit.
rules.notes: Biennial renewal in April; odd-numbered licenses renew in odd years, even-numbered in even years. At least 20 h in person (live interactive webinars count); max 20 h remote.
rules.rule_quote: …Forty (40) hours of approved continuing education is required for each renewal period.
